<ParamField body="disabled" type="boolean" default="false">
  Prevents resizing and activation and removes the separator from the tab order.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="edge" type="&quot;bottom&quot; | &quot;left&quot; | &quot;right&quot; | &quot;top&quot;" required>
  Physical panel edge. Left and top reverse the size change; right and bottom follow pointer movement.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="gapSize" type="number" default="0">
  Space occupied by the gap placement, in CSS pixels.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="maxSize" type="number" required>
  Maximum allowed size.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="minSize" type="number" required>
  Minimum allowed size.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onActivate" type="(() =&gt; void)">
  Requests activation on a click without dragging or on Enter or Space. The application decides whether to collapse or close the panel.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onResizeEnd" type="((details: { cancelled: boolean; size: number; }) =&gt; void)">
  Reports whether the pointer drag was cancelled and its final or restored size.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onResizeStart" type="((size: number) =&gt; void)">
  Reports the first candidate size when a pointer drag passes the movement threshold.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onSizeCommitted" type="((size: number) =&gt; void)">
  Reports the final size after a successful drag or a keyboard size change. Save controlled sizes here.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="onSizePreview" type="((size: number) =&gt; void)">
  Reports live size updates and the restored starting size after cancellation. Apply this size to the panel layout.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="placement" type="&quot;edge&quot; | &quot;gap&quot;" default="edge">
  An absolute edge inside a positioned panel, or a gap in the surrounding layout.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
  with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

  Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="scale" type="number | (() =&gt; number)" default="1">
  Positive CSS zoom or scale factor, or a function evaluated at pointer down. Pointer distance is divided by this value.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="showGrip" type="boolean" default="true">
  Shows the grip on the edge placement. Does not disable interaction.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="size" type="number" required>
  Required committed size in CSS pixels. The handle maintains a separate live size during a drag.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="step" type="number" default="10">
  Keyboard arrow increment in size units. Pointer movement is not snapped.
</ParamField>
